title: Classic text moves to GPT-6 Luna
summary:
Classic text moved to GPT-6 Luna, while Bison 1 added decision scoring and Whisper Turbo added another transcription option.

Classic text now uses GPT-6 Luna while keeping existing caller model names. Replies can run to 1,500 tokens instead of 800. The route sends no reasoning, so reasoning tokens do not take up the reply cap. It uses Azure Flex, which has no latency SLA and can return a busy response when capacity is full.

Added paid-only `baseten/bison-1` for scoring predefined yes/no, choice, and ordinal questions from text, JSON, or images. It accepts up to 16 reference images through the decisions endpoints or chat adapter.

Added paid-only `openai/whisper-large-v3-turbo` to `/v1/audio/transcriptions`, with word timestamps and subtitle output. Existing `whisper-large-v3` routes remain unchanged.
